title: PhantomPlay Unreal Flagships
design_pillars: PhantomStrike, Phantom Ages, and Phantom Legends are separate game identities inside one Unreal source project.
Each flagship launches in its own independently resizable native window and never falls back to a retired web or Panda3D build.
Gameplay systems must be real, responsive, inspectable, and game-specific rather than decorative.
PhantomPlay remains a multi-engine platform for unrelated Unity, Godot, Panda3D, web, Unreal, and native uploads.
Cubetown joins the shared Unreal production project as an additional native title without changing the exactly-three flagship identity contract.
visual_direction: PhantomStrike targets a premium modern tactical FPS presentation with readable combat spaces and immediate weapon feedback.
Phantom Ages uses a fixed orthographic lane-battle view with literal formations, towers, projectiles, research, and age progression.
Phantom Legends uses an elevated fantasy RTS and base-building view with selection, economy, construction, armies, and persistent progression.
Cubetown uses a colorful elevated voxel-adventure view with tactile building, captured creature echoes, shrine restoration, and systemic problem solving.
No visual work is complete until a compiled frame is captured and inspected on the actual target build.

audio_direction.engine_role: adaptive playback, spatial audio, mix states, and gameplay-synchronized transitions
audio_direction.rule: Unreal Engine plays and mixes approved music assets; it does not replace the primary PhantomFlow composition route.

performance_targets.measurement_rule: No performance claim without Unreal Insights or equivalent packaged-build evidence.
